[1/4] Plan the auto-refine loop: failing-first tests, prompt revision, best-take selection, attempts history, CLI flag

impact_assessment.why: The judge already returns concrete prompt suggestions, but the pipeline reports them and stops; a user must re-run and rewrite the prompt by hand to improve a rejected track
impact_assessment.benefits: One command retries a rejected track with the judge's own suggestions, keeps every attempt as evidence, and returns the best take, so automation can reach an acceptable score without a human loop
impact_assessment.risks: contract: new --attempts flag, CompositionResult.attempts, muse.json schema 2; dependency: none added; concurrency: none; state: one extra output folder per attempt, provider cost per attempt
impact_assessment.mitigation: Default attempts=1 preserves current behavior, cap at 5, reuse the existing atomic artifact path, stop early on acceptance, failing-first tests for every branch

[1/4] Plan batch mode: schema-checked JSON manifest, per-track compose with attempts, progress and JSON summary, failing-first tests

impact_assessment.why: A project soundtrack is a set of themes, but muse renders one track per command; running the CLI by hand loses the set-level result and makes automation repeat flags and error handling
impact_assessment.benefits: One manifest renders and judges every track, reuses the refine loop per track, and returns a single exit code and machine-readable summary
impact_assessment.risks: contract: new batch command and manifest format; dependency: none added; concurrency: none, tracks render sequentially; state: one artifact folder per take per track
impact_assessment.mitigation: Reject unknown keys and cap the manifest at 50 tracks, default attempts=1, keep the existing per-track evidence and atomic writes, failing-first tests for parsing and exits

[1/4] Plan resumable batch: per-track state written after every take, --resume reuses accepted tracks, --keep-going isolates failures, failing-first tests

impact_assessment.why: Batch mode stops on the first provider or judge failure, and rerunning the manifest re-renders and re-bills tracks that already succeeded
impact_assessment.benefits: A failed soundtrack run resumes at the first unfinished track, accepted evidence is reused, and one bad track no longer hides the rest of the set
impact_assessment.risks: contract: new --resume/--keep-going flags and a hidden batch state file; dependency: none added; concurrency: one sequential writer; state: output/.muse-batch-<hash>.json updated atomically per track
impact_assessment.mitigation: Hash the validated manifest so a changed manifest refuses resume, skip only accepted tracks, write state after each track, keep default stop-on-failure behavior without --keep-going, failing-first tests

impact_assessment.why: The feature work is complete but the project has not had a full defect audit; a push should ship verified code, not just passing happy-path tests
impact_assessment.benefits: Crash-safe artifact writes, clear validation for library callers, bounded manifest reads and a clean static check reduce silent corruption and traceback paths

[1/4] Plan round two: clean OSError boundary, trimmed/expanded env values, normalized Verdict sequences, malformed Gemini replies, and batch --dry-run with tests

impact_assessment.why: The first audit hardened storage and provider paths, but the CLI still tracebacks on raw OSError, env whitespace breaks names, Verdict accepts malformed sequences, Gemini assumes an object reply, and batch has no way to inspect a paid plan without spending
impact_assessment.benefits: Every filesystem failure is a clean 1 exit, environment values are forgiving, judge evidence is always well-typed, malformed replies fail with What/Why/Fix, and dry-run validates a manifest with zero provider calls
impact_assessment.risks: contract: new --dry-run flag and stricter Verdict/strip behaviour; dependency: none added; concurrency: none; state: dry-run writes no artifacts or state
impact_assessment.mitigation: Failing-first tests for every branch, keep valid inputs unchanged, no provider or filesystem writes in dry-run, full gates before commit
